newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indonesia's BDNI allots $78 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's BDNI allots $78 mln FRCD.

text.p: PT Bank Dagang Nasional Indonesia's US$78 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue has closed, the arrangers said on Friday.
The six-year issue, which was launched through the bank's Cayman Islands branch, comprises one tranche of US$38 million and another of US$40 million and has a put option at the end of year three.
They were issued at par to float at 70 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 85 basis points.
Arrangers, with US$6.8 million each, are Berliner Bank, BZW, Indover Bank, ING Barings and NatWest Markets.
Lead managers are WGZ-Bank, with US$6 million, and Arab Investment Co, Nord/LB and Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken, with US$5 million each.
Managers, with US$3 million each, are Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait, BNP Singapore, Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz Girozentrale, Landesbank Schleswig-Holstein International and Royal Bank of Scotland.
